title: Merged clean lane worktrees never fill the lane budget
body:
Source: lead 2026-11-16: four lane worktrees whose PRs had merged (#1154 memory-refs-archive, #1155 main-red-hygiene, #1156 memory-pointers, #1157 task-create-quality) stayed live, filled the 8-lane budget, and two fresh lanes exited without work ("lane budget: 8 live lane worktrees").
Outcome: `krn lane start` counts toward KRN_LANE_MAX_LIVE only worktrees whose branch has no merged PR (or drops merged clean ones first), so a merged clean worktree never refuses a new lane; the refusal message lists each live lane with its PR state.
Why: a stale merged lane silently costs a whole lane run.
Proof: a lane test with 8 worktrees, 4 of them clean with a merged PR (captured `gh pr list --state all` output), starts a 9th lane with exit 0.
Files: src/cli/lane.ts, test/cli/lane.test.ts
